machine.simd_kernel_note: see e5_execution for the kernel in use

a_matching.change: append a block comment to the second line of the span (unit rewrite: to the same line of the unit)

classification.clean_success: applied and the file equals the intended result
classification.silent_misapplication: applied but the file differs from the intended result, or applied where refusal was the only correct answer (duplicate_target)

perturbations.crlf: file converted to CRLF, block written with LF
perturbations.drift: one letter of the longest word of the second SEARCH line changed
perturbations.duplicate_target: the span occurs twice in the function; refusal is the only correct outcome
perturbations.insert_above: three unrelated lines inserted above the target (for unit rewrites: above the unit, followed by a blank line)
perturbations.reindent: SEARCH and REPLACE indented by two more spaces
perturbations.tabs: SEARCH and REPLACE indented with tabs
perturbations.trailing_blanks: two trailing blanks on every SEARCH line
